|game_text=Deploys only on Tatooine. During your deploy phase, if with [[URoRRuR'R'R (V){{!}}URoRRuR'R'R]], may deploy a weapon with 'Tusken' in lore here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle; your weapon destiny draws for such weapons are +2. During your deploy phase, may move [[Ur'Ru'r (V){{!}}Ur'Ru'r]] as a regular move.
|errata_history=The Players Committee website card list gives this revised text. The image is a recreation of that wording. The Players Committee later [[Ur'Ru'r (V) (Errata 2)|restored the earlier wording]].
* '''Original''' ([[Ur'Ru'r (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 1 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009).<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf#page=3 Virtual Block 1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 3, slip 26. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf#page=3 Internet Archive]</ref> Full text: “Deploys only on Tatooine. During your deploy phase, if with URoRRuR'R'R, may ▼ a weapon with "Tusken" in lore here; your weapon destiny draws for such weapons are +2. During your deploy phase, Ur'Ru'r may make a regular move.” Document: the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB1-26-Ur_Ru_r.png]]) prints slip number “26” bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text) changed “with "Tusken" in” to “with 'Tusken' in”, changed “phase, Ur'Ru'r” to “phase, may move Ur'Ru'r” and changed “Ur'Ru'r may make” to “Ur'Ru'r as”.<ref name="cl-1210_26-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock1Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref> Full text: “Deploys only on Tatooine. During your deploy phase, if with URoRRuR'R'R, may deploy a weapon with 'Tusken' in lore here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle; your weapon destiny draws for such weapons are +2. During your deploy phase, may move Ur'Ru'r as a regular move.” The PC website card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so its wording follows that data; it is listed as a version because the PC published it.
* '''Restored text''' ([[Ur'Ru'r (V) (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB1-D-urrur-pre.gif]]), on the PC website by 25 February 2013 (server upload date)<ref name="pcimg-Virtual1-Dark">Players Committee card image, file <code>cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual1-Dark/large/urrur.gif</code>; the directory listing of this folder (Virtual1-Dark) was not captured; the captured Legacy folders (Virtual2, Virtual4, Virtual5, Virtual6, Virtual7) all carry 25-Feb-2013 11:33/11:34, the date the PC rebuilt its image set (research R6, 11 November 2026: these are bulk upload dates, and an image may have been made earlier). Today's copy: https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/legacy/VirtualBlock1-Dark/large/urrur.gif. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009024239id_/https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/legacy/VirtualBlock1-Dark/large/urrur.gif Internet Archive].</ref>: “Deploys only on Tatooine. During your deploy phase, if with URoRRuR'R'R, may ▼ a weapon with "Tusken" in lore here; your weapon destiny draws for such weapons are +2. During your deploy phase, Ur'Ru'r may make a regular move.”
* '''Master List reprint''': Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side p. 15), official text as of 27 April 2013<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=15, page 15. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=15 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploys only on Tatooine. During your deploy phase, if with URoRRuR'R'R, may ▼ a weapon with "Tusken" in lore here; your weapon destiny draws for such weapons are +2. During your deploy phase, Ur'Ru'r may make a regular move.”
